improve.exec: mkdir -p bundle out && tar -xzf uploads/improve-bundle.tar.gz -C bundle && ls bundle bundle/failures

subagent.name: analyst
subagent.input: Read bundle/failures and report what went wrong in the process.

improve.exec:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, re
ids = sorted(os.listdir('bundle/failures'))
seen, cited = set(), []
for f in ids:
    a = f.replace('--', '/', 1)
    t = re.sub(r'-\d+$', '', a.split('/')[1])
    if t not in seen:
        seen.add(t); cited.append(a)
os.makedirs('out/agent/skills/fix-workflow', exist_ok=True)
text = open('bundle/agent/skills/fix-workflow/SKILL.md').read().replace('3. **Fix.** Change the source, not the tests.', '3. **Fix.** Change the source, not the tests. Check the same rule on the boundary values next to the reported one.')
open('out/agent/skills/fix-workflow/SKILL.md', 'w').write(text)
json.dump({'cause': 'Stopped at the reported example', 'rule': 'Check neighbouring boundary values', 'cited': cited[:2], 'predicted_effect': 'Fewer partial fixes'}, open('out/diagnosis.json', 'w'))
json.dump({'files': ['agent/skills/fix-workflow/SKILL.md']}, open('out/manifest.json', 'w'))
open('out/LEARNED.md', 'w').write('I stopped at the reported example instead of checking the values next to it.')
print(cited)
PY
